svg.title: Tatawwu Bahrain — project design specification
svg.text: Express & Postman · Success responses · Paths are relative to the backend server URL · Protected requests use Bearer JWT
TATAWWU' / BAHRAIN / ENGLISH / MERN + JWT + CLOUDINARY
Grant or retry an eligible certificate
Favorites: PUT returns 201 for a new save or 200 if already saved; DELETE returns 204 even when already absent.
Unavailable favorites expose only campaignId and available: false. PUT requires visibility even if saved; unavailable targets return 404.
Issue: 201 when first issued; 200 when already issued; 202 while processing. Express streams authenticated Cloudinary PDFs to the recipient.
Preview/download: fetch with Bearer JWT, then display/download a Blob. Private/no-store caching; no client Cloudinary PDF URLs.
Admin decisions require current revision. Rejection/removal requires a reason. Approval accepts approved or rejected.
